findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：面臨全球與本地競爭者，包含低成本製造商進入造成價格壓力，中國有本土廠商優勢。
findings.excerpt: We also encounter competition from the entry of low-cost manufacturers, which may lead to increased pricing pressure. In certain countries, and particularly in China, we face competition from domestic medical device companies that may benefit from their status as local suppliers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：新競爭者可能出現（新銷售模式、機器人、導航、自動化技術），次世代產品延遲可能導致市占下滑。
findings.excerpt: New competitors may emerge in the future, potentially including companies introducing new sales or distribution models to our industry or leveraging genomic, robotic, navigation, and/or other automation technologies.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要為二手改寫、無逐字原文，故僅列線索：BTIG 醫師調查預期 BSX PFA 份額 2025 年 58%→2026 年 48%（J&J、Medtronic 上升）；Abbott Amulet 360 取得 CE mark 與 Watchman 競爭，Watchman 成長放緩被連結到 2026 指引下調（來源為搜尋摘要，未核原文）。
